name: project
description: Detect projects needing attention, dispatch tasks or owner agent sessions. Event triggers provide immediate reaction; timer is backup scan.

name: project-creative-audit

name: metric-alert-reactor
description: React to metric.breach and metric.stalled events by forking the owning agent with a remediation task. P0 breaches get immediate fork; P1/P2 get explicit triage after grace period. P3 alerts stay visible through metric context. Polls unresolved alerts every 5min.

name: closed-loop-steward
message: [cron:closed-loop-steward] Audit whether red metrics and failed deliveries are moving toward closure.
description: May-owned closed-loop audit. Handler builds live context from open metric alerts, failed deliveries, and owner activity. Frequency can be tuned independently from heartbeat.

name: session-recovery
description: React to failed sessions by dispatching the session-recovery workflow; timer fallback auto-closes stale immediate sessions with no assistant activity.

name: evaluator-aftermath

handler.task: Evaluate the completed session, produce metrics/evaluation signal, fix obvious low-risk root causes, escalate when blocked, and capture reusable learning.

description: Run evaluator aftermath workflow when a session ends.

name: session-aftermath-scan
description: Every 7 minutes, evaluate terminal sessions missed by the completion event; skip sessions ended less than 7 minutes ago.

name: eval-llm-scan

handler.task: Explore arXiv for recent AI agent papers. Use this exact API base only: https://export.arxiv.org/api/query . Never use http://export.arxiv.org.
